reasoning_steps: Identify the polynomial P(x) with nonzero coefficients.
Replace the nonzero coefficients of P(x) with their mean to form Q(x).
Note that the graph of Q(x) will be a scaled version of P(x).
Compare the graphs of P(x) and Q(x) within the interval -4 ≤ x ≤ 4.
Identify the graph that shows the transformation from P(x) to Q(x).
